label: Counting paths by dynamic programming
subgoals: Set the path count at each source to 1
Sum the counts of all predecessors at each vertex
Add the counts at the sinks to get the total

label: Paths through one vertex
subgoals: Count paths from each vertex to the sinks in a backward pass
Multiply paths in by paths out at the vertex
Use the product to rank how many paths share a gate

label: Exponential path explosion
subgoals: Multiply stage widths to count paths through reconvergent stages
Compare the path count with the vertex count
Choose per-vertex propagation over path enumeration
